# PDF.js 5.6.205

Vendored browser build and runtime assets from the official pdfjs-dist 5.6.205 package.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and individual font / CMap licenses.

Used by document-photo-viewer.js for local multi-page PDF evidence viewing.
No PDF evidence is sent to an external viewer.
